242.title: Antiemetic Potion
242.content:
Add these in order: <style="highlight">dragonblood leaf</style>, <style="highlight">zen orchid</style>, and <style="highlight">stargrass</style>; simmer briefly to finish.
Note: Brewing time affects potency—too short or too long reduces effect.
Extra Note: Honestly, you don't need perfection. As long as it works, that's enough.

242.title: 吐き気止めのレシピ
242.content:
<style="highlight">竜血葉</style>、<style="highlight">清心蘭</style>、<style="highlight">星屑草</style>を順に加え、短時間煮込めば完成。
注意：煮込み時間は薬効に影響。短すぎても長すぎても、効果が落ちる可能性あり。
注意への注意：とはいえ、そこまで効かなくても良い。
